title: This is huge!  Three feet across!
text: This is huge!  Three feet across!. It comes ready for you to shape it yourself - which will take some time considering the size.  It’s heavy and will be a bit difficult to hang.  It arrived too late to use for Christmas.  If a light goes out, it can’t be replaced - but all the other lights will still work.  Considering how many lights there are, this probably won’t be a problem.  Hanging it high enough to get the full effect is giving us a problem.  Trees are out as we are in our very windy season.  Looks like a project for next Christmas or a very special occasion!
